About PGHub

India's most trusted platform for finding verified PGs and hostels

Our Story

Built for students, by people who were students

PGHub was created to solve one of India's most frustrating problems: finding a safe, affordable, and comfortable PG as a student or new professional in an unfamiliar city. We've aggregated the best verified listings across 14 major Indian cities — from Vidisha to Mumbai — with transparent pricing and direct contact options.

Our AI assistant helps you find the right PG instantly, our 360° view feature lets you tour rooms before you visit, and Google Maps integration gets you there seamlessly.
